AI/Data Platform Engineer Python, LLM, ML

Client: TDC Net A/S
Experience: 5 to 8 Years
Location: Open / Hybrid
Role Type: AI & Data Engineering

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Platform Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and LLM-based application development. The ideal candidate will design, build, and maintain scalable AI platforms, data pipelines, and production-grade GenAI solutions. The role requires hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, MLOps practices, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering principles. [TDC AI_Dat...neer 1 (1) | Word], [linkedin.com]

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop scalable AI/ML and data platform solutions using Python.
Build and maintain LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and RAG pipelines.
Develop data ingestion, transformation, and processing workflows.
Implement LLM orchestration using LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, or similar frameworks.
Build APIs and backend services for AI applications.
Integrate AI systems with enterprise data sources, databases, and external services.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
Deploy AI solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native services.
Monitor model performance, reliability, observability, and platform health.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product teams to deliver business-focused AI solutions.
Establish best practices for security, governance, testing, and production readiness
